Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 
CROWN FOR WRIST WATCH CASE 



1. Scope — Covers the dimensional and other requirements of the following two types of crowns 
for wrist watch case: 

Type A — for non-water-resistant wrist watch 
Type B — for water-resistant wrist watch

Note 1 — There is no established relation between diameters d lt d* and d 5 on one side and length / 2 , / 3 and 
diameters d 3 and d 4 on the other. Dimensions may be chosen depending upon actual requirements. 

Note 2 — Actual value for </ 2 shall be determined with the help of pitch for knurled teeth. The values of d x 
given above are only for illustrating the designation. 



3. Designation — Crown of Type B having outside diameter di = 5 mm, suitable for case pipe of 
outside diameter 2*5 mm and length 1*9 mm, having crown tube length / 2 = 2'5 mm and thread 
diameter tf 4 = 0'9 mm shall be designated as: 

Crown B 5'0 X 2'5 X 1'9 X 2*5 X 0*9 IS : 9673 

4. Material — Free-cutting brass conforming to Type 1 of IS: 319-1974 'Free-cutting brass bars, 
rods and sections ( third revision ) \ 

5. Finish 

i) Stainless steel covering, 
ii) Gold plated, coating thickness S^m, min 
iii) Chrome plated, total plating thickness 8/|xm, min 



IS: 9673 -1980 

8. Packing — Crowns of the same type and size shall be wrapped in tissue paper and packed in a 
suitable cardboard or plastic container. 

7. Certification Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard is one of a series of Indian Standards relating to wrist watch case. In the 
preparation of this standard, assistar*ee has been derived from DIN 8297-1971 Winding buttons for 
wrist watches. Deutsches Institutfur Normung.
